name: my-11--deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017
question: How are new EPF contributions split between member accounts in Malaysia?
answer: Since May 2024, new EPF contributions are split: 75% to Akaun Persaraan (Retirement), 15% to Akaun Sejahtera (Well-being), and 10% to Akaun Fleksibel (Flexible). For members under 60, the employer's 13% and employee's 11% follow this allocation. Akaun Fleksibel allows withdrawals anytime, Akaun Sejahtera for housing/education/health, and Akaun Persaraan only at age 55/60.
